card.title: Access Has a Price
card.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce you to the curator if you hang my exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can you send her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Could you collect my frames too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Give me her email; I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct access includes taking the show down. Shall I put you down for Sunday?

mechanism: A turns successive curator-access requests into setup, collection and teardown obligations.
confusable: Unlike asking one favor for an introduction, A must attach a new price to each additional informational shortcut.
comparison: D70-b charges extra for direct contact; D70-a charges extra for possessing the key rather than receiving an opened door.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
